item.title: RyukGram v446.0.0
item.description:
Instagram 446.0.0 | RyukGram v1.4.0 — fallback snapshot of the developer's source.
Setting profiles, mobile-config browser, story stats, custom fonts, full-resolution photo downloads, reorderable post and reel buttons, view-once media capture while the app is closed and an update checker. See the live RyukSign source for the full release notes.
